Chapter 1208: Chapter 23: Third Realm, The Heavenly Pillar Descending from the Sky (Please Subscribe)

A thousand years, for a Twelfth Layer life form, is but a fleeting moment.

The Galactic Chaos Continent becomes increasingly prosperous, frequently visited even by strong beings at the level of the Chaos Great Saint seeking Lin Yuan.

Occasionally, Chaos Great Saints would exchange insights, validating the chaotic paths they had evolved, something Lin Yuan valued greatly.

Based on chaos as the foundation, the paths of power evolved, though varied in strength, are essentially part of the Dao. Lin Yuan’s observation of other chaotic evolution paths also supplements his understanding of the Great Dao.

Deep within the Galactic Chaos Continent.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged.

In front of him, strands of Chaos Qi constantly formed secret patterns, only to dissipate quickly after a brief moment.

After dissipating, they would continue to condense again, repeating perpetually as if without end.

"Chaos Rule..."

Lin Yuan immersed himself in circulating the Chaos Qi, focusing part of his mind on comprehending the Chaos Mystic Pattern Diagram.

The Chaos Mystic Pattern Diagram, gathered by the Ancestor of the Fierce Sun of the Thirteenth Layer in the Fang Yuan World with great divine skills, contains the essential threads of the Chaos Rule.

It is one of Lin Yuan’s main objects of comprehension.

"So that’s how it is."

Unaware of how much time had passed.

Lin Yuan silently opened his eyes, a deep gaze with brewing chaos energy, and the mystic pattern diagram composed of Chaos Qi before him rapidly became complete and clear.

If a Heavenly Venerate from the Fierce Sun Ancient Country were to watch, they would find this Chaos Mystic Pattern Diagram nearly identical to the twenty-eighth Chaos Mystic Pattern Diagram.

There are a total of eighty-one Chaos Mystic Pattern Diagrams passed down by the Ancestor of the Fierce Sun.

Those representing the Chaos First Realm are the first eight diagrams.

The diagrams from the ninth to the twenty-seventh represent the Chaos Second Realm.

The twenty-eighth Chaos Mystic Pattern Diagram... marks the field of the Chaos Third Realm.

Now that Lin Yuan briefly replicated the twenty-seventh Chaos Mystic Pattern Diagram, it signifies that in his understanding of the Chaos Rule, he has fully entered the Third Realm.

"Chaos evolves all things."

Lin Yuan was invigorated; after reaching the Third Realm of chaos comprehension, he gained a clearer understanding of the essence of all things.

The basic structure of the Chaos Void, the process of chaos evolution, to Lin Yuan, was as clear as turning over his hand to view a pattern.

"All things will return to chaos again."

Lin Yuan’s gaze was profound, looking into the vast Chaos Void.

At this moment, Lin Yuan’s realm elevated infinitely, as if seeing countless millions of Cosmic Eras rotate in the Chaos Void, and there will eventually come a day when the whole Chaos Void will undergo a great collapse like the innate cosmos.

Everything in the Chaos Void will return to chaos.

"Not only the Chaos Void, but the Origin World is like this as well."

Lin Yuan thought to himself, though he wasn’t worried, as the existence of the Chaos Void and the Origin World are so massive, their cycles of destruction are too lengthy; lengthy enough that even the lifetime of an Invincible Great Saint is but a speck in the ocean.

...

"Chaos Rule Third Realm..."

A smile appeared on Lin Yuan’s face; a thousand years of arduous cultivation had pushed his comprehension of the Chaos Rule further, which wasn’t beyond his expectations.

The Chaos Mystic Pattern Diagram’s aid in understanding the Chaos Rule was immense, as it was virtually a shortcut—or rather, even more convenient than a shortcut.

This was also the feedback from the Thirteenth Layer ancestors of the six Ancient Countries in the Fang Yuan World to their descendants and living beings.

In the Chaos Void, Invincible Great Saints, who are seldom born even in tens or millions of Cosmic Eras, are present in every era of the six Ancient Countries. For instance, the Fu Xu Venerate in the Da Fu Ancient Country, who possesses the battle strength akin to an Invincible Great Saint of the Chaos Void, is not alone there.

It’s not that the beings of the Chaos Void are inferior to those of the Origin World, but rather that the attitude of the Twelfth Layer lives in the two dimensional worlds towards lower-level beings is different.

The Thirteenth Layer ancestors of the Origin World tend to value them greatly, even worry over them extensively.

Whereas the Thirteenth Layer time lives of the Chaos Void are somewhat laissez-faire.

If the Thirteenth Layer time lives of the Chaos Void left many legacies and provided opportunities like ’possessions’, it’s believed that the Chaos Void would also birth Invincible Great Saints.

...

"My power..."

Lin Yuan carefully sensed for a while.

Reaching the Chaos Rule Third Realm.

For Lin Yuan, the direct enhancement in strength isn’t too significant or exaggerated.

But the indirect enhancement...is immeasurable.

Firstly, there’s the evolution of the Chaotic Taiji Dao. At this moment, Lin Yuan clearly perceives that the time for the giant egg gestating within his internal universe to fully evolve the Chaotic Taiji Dao is essentially within ten years.

"Ten years."

Lin Yuan was excited; the Chaos Taiyin Taiyang Taiji Dao has been the path he chose since the Second Layer, which can be said to be the final Tao Fruit he has been cultivating all along.

This Tao Fruit did not disappoint Lin Yuan; while other Great Saints and Great Lords need only the Chaos First Realm to evolve their chaotic power paths, the Chaotic Taiji Dao requires the pinnacle of the Chaos Second Realm to reach the threshold of evolution.

This is already due to Lin Yuan’s extraordinary insight; if it were other strong beings, they probably wouldn’t start evolving until they reached a Third Realm comprehension of chaos.

Chaos Rule Third Realm? Only starting to evolve the chaotic power path then?

For a Chaos Great Saint, this isn’t a good thing.

Because the Chaos Third Realm is extremely difficult to reach, and before evolving the chaotic power path, no matter how high the rule comprehension is, it is equivalent to a peak Venerate.

Even in the six Ancient Countries where rule comprehension is easier, generally, only the top Peak Venerables can achieve the Third Realm of chaos rule comprehension.

And without evolving the chaotic power path, one isn’t even a Great Lord, making the transition exceedingly difficult.
